mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within a month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales by more than 1% over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decrease by more than 5% and GDP growth is negative over the same quarter, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decrease > 5% and GDPC1 < 0 in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 5% and GDPC1 was negative over the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month, coupled with a CPI increase of more than 0.3%, signals strong labor demand and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.5% for more than three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales by more than 1% over three months, coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate by more than 0.2% over the same period, signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% over three months.
